page.title: For Property Owners - List Your Property
page.description: List your property on Hospeda and reach thousands of travelers in the Argentine Litoral. Professional management, statistics and dedicated support for owners.

1.q: How much does it cost to list my property?
1.a: Listing requires a host plan, and every plan includes a {{trialDays}}-day free trial. We charge no booking commission: the subscription is the only cost.

2.a: Travelers contact you directly by WhatsApp, email, or phone. You handle everything.

3.q: Can I list more than one property?
3.a: Yes. Each plan sets how many properties you can keep published at once, so pick the one that fits your case.

4.q: What kinds of accommodation can I list?
4.a: Country houses, cabins, apartments, hotels, apart hotels, campsites, and more.

landing.trialCallout: Try Hospeda free for 14 days. Your trial starts when you publish your first property. You won't be charged until day 14, no commitment.
